result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     St John of God Health Care (SJGHC) is one of the largest private providers of health care services in Australia, employing more than 16,000 employees (caregivers). We operate 26 hospitals and services comprising more than 3,300 hospital beds, including home nursing, disability services and social outreach programs.

This is a unique opportunity for an exceptional and visionary General Manager, Data & AI to establish and lead our AI and Data Analytics Centre of Excellence (ACoE) and drive the next phase of our data and digital transformation journey.

Reporting to the Chief Technology & Corporate Services Officer, this pivotal role will shape how data, analytics and artificial intelligence are leveraged across the organisation to improve clinical outcomes, enhance operational performance and support strategic decision-making. You will champion a data-driven culture, helping leaders across our hospitals and services unlock the value of information to deliver better outcomes for patients, employees (caregivers) and the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the growth of SJGHC's AI and Data Analytics Centre of Excellence (ACoE), driving a culture of innovation and data-informed decision making.

Develop and execute the enterprise AI, data and analytics strategy to support organisational performance, clinical excellence and strategic priorities.

Lead the use of data, analytics and artificial intelligence to deliver actionable insights, improve outcomes and create business value across the organisation.

Provide leadership and oversight of enterprise data governance, information management, reporting and analytics frameworks.

Build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary team across data, analytics and AI functions.

Partner with executive, clinical and operational leaders to advance digital innovation, interoperability and evidence-based decision making.

Drive the development of modern data platforms and analytical capabilities that support precision medicine, population health and operational excellence.

Identify and leverage emerging technologies, data sources and AI opportunities to deliver transformational outcomes for patients, caregivers and the organisation.

To be successful, you will be a strategic and influential leader with significant experience leading enterprise data, analytics, business intelligence or AI functions within a large and complex environment. You will combine strong technical expertise with exceptional stakeholder engagement, change leadership and people management skills.

Experience driving organisational transformation, establishing governance frameworks and translating complex data into meaningful business outcomes will be essential. Exposure to healthcare, highly regulated industries or complex service environments will be highly regarded.

This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of AI and analytics within a values-based healthcare organisation that is committed to innovation and excellence.

Above all, people will be at the core of everything you do committing to and supporting our Mission and Values.

We can offer you

Competitive remuneration and benefits

Permanent Full-Time position

Based in Perth or Melbourne

Salary packaging up to $18,550 on a range of benefits such as mortgage, rent, meal entertainment, holiday accommodation or other everyday living expenses as well as options to salary package benefits above the FBT cap on items such as:

Novated leasing 

work related expenses

self-education and

additional superannuation

A healthy work-life balance through flexible work options, additional purchased leave and well-being programs

Employee discount on St John of God Hospital & Medical Services and Private Health Insurance

Employee support through our dedicated free Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Access to a range of Lifestyle, Health & Wellbeing rewards and discounts

For enquiries, please call Carly Smith, Senior Manager Recruitment on 08 6116 0533.

St John of God Health Care embraces diversity and strongly encourages applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and people with disabilities. We are committed to providing a safe environment for all children and vulnerable people in our care and proactively take measures to protect children-vulnerable people from abuse. CHE QLD is seeking for a highly qualified and experienced Welders to join their team of professionals on a full-time and permanent basis.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Full-Time Opportunities | Perth, WA & Townsville, QLD | Employer 
Sponsorship Available
MYAC Resources is currently recruiting experienced Mechanical Fitters for multiple 
permanent, full-time opportunities across Perth, Western Australia and Townsville, 
Queensland.
We partner with leading Australian employers across manufacturing, heavy industry, 
mining, engineering and industrial sectors, offering long-term career opportunities 
with reputable businesses.
Whether you are already in Australia or looking to relocate from overseas, we 
encourage suitably qualified Mechanical Fitters to apply. Employer sponsorship is 
available for eligible candidates, subject to employer requirements and Australian 
migration regulations.
About the Role
As a Mechanical Fitter, you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, 
repair and servicing of industrial machinery and mechanical equipment to ensure 
safe and efficient operations.
Depending on the employer and project, your responsibilities may include:
• Mechanical maintenance, servicing and fault finding on industrial plant and 
equipment 
• Preventative maintenance and scheduled servicing 
• Breakdown repairs to minimise downtime 
• Installation, alignment and commissioning of mechanical equipment 
• Repair and replacement of bearings, motors, pumps, gearboxes, conveyors 
and other mechanical components 
• Hydraulic and pneumatic maintenance 
• Reading and interpreting engineering drawings and technical documentation 
• Performing equipment inspections and reporting maintenance requirements 
• Completing maintenance records and documentation 
• Working safely in accordance with company procedures and WHS 
requirements 
Collaborating with maintenance and production teams to maximise equipment 
reliability 
About You
To be successful, you will ideally have:
• Certificate III in Engineering – Mechanical Trade (Mechanical Fitter) or 
equivalent recognised trade qualification 
• Previous experience in manufacturing, heavy industry, mining, industrial 
maintenance or engineering environments 
• Strong mechanical fault-finding and diagnostic skills 
• Experience maintaining rotating equipment and industrial machinery 
• Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals 
• Strong problem-solving ability 
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills 
• Commitment to workplace health and safety 
Highly Regarded
The following experience and licences are advantageous:
• Experience within mining, manufacturing or steel processing 
• Hydraulic and pneumatic systems experience 
• Conveyor and materials handling equipment experience 
• Welding and fabrication experience 
• Forklift Licence 
• Overhead Crane Licence 
• Elevated Work Platform (EWP) 
• Confined Space and Working at Heights tickets 
• Experience using maintenance management systems (CMMS)
Employer Sponsorship Available
MYAC Resources has extensive experience assisting Australian businesses to 
recruit skilled tradespeople from both within Australia and overseas.
For suitably qualified candidates, employer sponsorship may be available, subject to 
employer approval and Australian migration requirements.
If you are seeking to build a long-term career in Australia, we would love to hear from 
you.
What's on Offer
• Permanent full-time opportunities 
• Positions available in Perth, WA and Townsville, QLD
• Competitive salary packages with overtime opportunities 
• Long-term career progression 
• Work with established Australian employers 
• Ongoing training and professional development 
• Safe, supportive and well-managed workplaces 
• Employer sponsorship available for eligible candidates 
Why MYAC Resources?
MYAC Resources specialises in recruiting skilled professionals across Australia's 
manufacturing, engineering, mining, construction and industrial sectors.
We focus on building long-term careers by connecting talented tradespeople with 
quality employers throughout Australia. Our experienced recruitment team provides 
support throughout every stage of the recruitment process, from application through 
to placement and, where applicable, employer sponsorship.
Apply Now
If you're an experienced Mechanical Fitter looking for your next opportunity in Perth
or Townsville, we'd love to hear from you.
Send your resume to recruitment@myacresources.com.au
Apply today with your current resume and one of our recruitment specialists will be in
